versions.changelog: Tracks overllm 0.7.0 — LangChain LCEL/bound-model detection, embeddings-in-loop, kwargs-splat and module-constant prompt recall, and the json-mode-missing-json rule.
Tracks overllm 0.6.2 — the --fix correctness patch (fixed silent file corruption on non-ASCII lines, scan-abort crashes, and baseline gaps). Skill installs the latest overllm.
Docs: correct the read-only wording now that --fix edits files; plainer developer voice.
Reposition: lead with 'find the LLM call you didn't need'. Docs for wrapper recall, llm_calls allowlist, --baseline, safe --fix, and --format github (overllm 0.6.0).
Tune description for search: lead with cost/token reduction
First release — flags needless LLM/AI calls, static and local
